name: Muhammad Ali
bio: Muhammad Ali was an American professional boxer and civil rights activist regarded as one of the most significant and celebrated figures of the 20th century. Nicknamed 'The Greatest', he was the world heavyweight champion three separate times and participated in legendary bouts like the 'Fight of the Century' and the 'Rumble in the Jungle'. Ali's steadfast refusal to serve in the Vietnam War made him a global icon of religious and racial freedom.

faq.q: What was Muhammad Ali's original birth name?
faq.a: He was born Cassius Marcellus Clay Jr., before converting to Islam and adopting the name Muhammad Ali in 1964.

faq.q: What is Ali's famous fighting phrase?
faq.a: Ali described his nimble style as: 'Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee. His hands can't hit what his eyes can't see.'

name: Mike Tyson
nickname: Iron Mike / The Baddest Man on the Planet
bio: Michael Gerard Tyson is an American former professional boxer who reigned as the undisputed world heavyweight champion from 1987 to 1990. He holds the record as the youngest boxer in history to win a heavyweight title, claiming the WBC belt at just 20 years, 4 months, and 22 days old. Famous for his ferociously intimidating knockout power and peek-a-boo defense, Tyson won his first 19 professional fights by knockout, 12 in the first round.

faq.q: How old was Mike Tyson when he won his first world championship?
faq.a: He was 20 years and 4 months old when he knocked out Trevor Berbick in November 1986.

faq.q: Who was Tyson's legendary trainer and mentor?
faq.a: Tyson was trained and mentored by legendary Hall of Fame boxing coach Cus D'Amato.
